Not yet. The proposed build leaves out parts that are central to what I asked for, especially keeping a saved copy and tracking what I still want to read. I don’t want those deferred from the first usable version.

Before implementation, please walk me through:

- Marking links unread/read and viewing only unread links.
- Archiving and restoring links, separately from permanently deleting them.
- Preserving a local copy of a page, preserving the actual file for PDFs, and optionally sending a copy to the Internet Archive.
- Selecting several links—or all links matching the current search or filter—to add/remove tags, change read status, archive, or delete.
- Saving a useful combination of search and included or excluded tags for reuse.
- Importing my existing browser bookmarks and exporting them again while retaining titles, tags, and original dates.
- Preferences for default sorting, number displayed, and text size.

Once those behaviors are settled alongside the current flows, I’ll be comfortable approving implementation.
